To determine which protein is heavier between the products of **CLIC2** and **GOSR2**, we retrieved their canonical protein sequences and molecular masses from UniProt:

- **CLIC2** (Chloride intracellular channel protein 2; UniProt [O15247](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/O15247)):
  - Length: 247 amino acids
  - Molecular mass: 28,356 Da (~**28.36 kDa**)

- **GOSR2** (Golgi SNAP receptor complex member 2; UniProt [O14653](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/O14653)):
  - Length: 265 amino acids (canonical isoform 1)
  - Molecular mass: 30,969 Da (~**30.97 kDa**)

Comparing the two, the protein encoded by **GOSR2** is heavier than the protein encoded by **CLIC2**.
